decoded.meaning: An ILLEGAL PATH: reference/05 §PATH requires every child to be a NAME TLV (type=0x02). These children are VALUE (0x01). The bytes are well-formed TLV, so a CODEC decodes and round-trips them; a RESOLVER must refuse to address a vertex with them and answer ERROR{tr::path::invalid} (0x0021).
decoded.note: Not a reject.bin case: reject.bin means DECODE must fail (HARNESS.md §negative cases), and decoding is not where this is caught. See description.md.
